meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 接管你的 Git 操作：提交前先分析改动，按目录和用途拆成多个原子提交，并照仓库已有的提交风格和语言写提交信息；也做 rebase、squash 和查某行是谁改的、何时加入。
howto.when: 当你说出 commit、rebase、squash 等关键词，或要查某次改动由谁、何时引入时接管。

say.text: 把当前改动拆成原子提交
say.note: 会先输出风格检测和提交计划

say.text: 帮我把这几条提交 rebase 并 squash
say.note: 历史改写前会先判断分支是否安全

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的、哪次提交加的

howto.what_en: Takes over Git work: before committing it analyzes changes, splits them into atomic commits by directory and purpose, matches the repo's commit style and language, and handles rebase, squash, and history lookup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention commit, rebase, squash or similar keywords, or ask who wrote a line and when a change was introduced.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: Prints its style detection and commit plan first

say_en.text: Rebase and squash these commits for me
say_en.note: Checks branch safety before rewriting history

say_en.text: Find who wrote this line and in which commit
say_en.note: Uses blame, bisect, log -S and similar
